headline: Wyoming outwins the conference without topping its table
dek: Wyoming has won fourteen matches this season, more than any other side in the conference. In goal, Haley Bartel has kept ten clean sheets for a defense that has conceded nineteen goals all season.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Colorado College tops the conference table though it has conceded more goals than it has scored this season, 27 against 23: its conference wins have come by narrow margins, not by weight of scoring.

wire.line: Air Force took twelve wins into the conference's last match of the season, and lost it at Colorado.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Grand Canyon's season opener at New Mexico State has no published result, the only match on the conference's schedule past its date without one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sydney Nelms has made 101 saves for Air Force at a save percentage of .828.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alyssa Glover has ten goals and nine assists for Wyoming, from 64 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Thirteen different players have scored for Air Force this season.

last_match.line: Air Force's first defeat since Wyoming beat it at the start of November; no conference side has a match left to play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
